blocks.raw: Points represent loyalty points of an organization that are issued to the loyalty customers through different sources such as Loyalty Manager, Data Import (import profiles) and Member Care (GoodWill points). Customers can redeem their points against transactions.
blocks.text: Points represent loyalty points of an organization that are issued to the loyalty customers through different sources such as Loyalty Manager, Data Import (import profiles) and Member Care (GoodWill points). Customers can redeem their points against transactions.

blocks.raw:
> 📘
>
> Points cannot be issued through APIs. It can be issued only through modules such as Loyalty Manager, Data Import and Member Care.
blocks.text: Points cannot be issued through APIs. It can be issued only through modules such as Loyalty Manager, Data Import and Member Care.

blocks.raw: The APIs of points entity are interdependent. For example, to redeem points, first you need to check whether a customer can redeem those points (`isredeemable`), validate customer’s registered mobile number by issuing validation code, and then redeem points using the validation code received by the customer.
blocks.text: The APIs of points entity are interdependent. For example, to redeem points, first you need to check whether a customer can redeem those points (isredeemable), validate customer’s registered mobile number by issuing validation code, and then redeem points using the validation code received by the customer.

blocks.raw: The points entity allows you to perform the following tasks -
blocks.text: The points entity allows you to perform the following tasks -

blocks.raw:
* Check whether a specific number of points can be redeemed by a customer
* Issue validation code to the registered mobile number/email id to validate customer
* Redeem points using the validation code received by the customer
